description.value:
Fighting smart doesn't mean fighting fair. This pawn can make hidden spike unarmed attacks. These deal 1 piercing damage, are in the knife group, and have the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits. A small, hollow reservoir inside the pawn can store one dose of injury poison, applied when this Strike hits. Inserting or removing a poison takes 3 Interact actions.

Alternatively, a beneficial substance (such as an elixir of life) can be placed in the reservoir and injected into a willing creature within reach as a single action.

The poison/elixir reservoir isn't tracked automatically; the GM and players track it by hand.
